<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, and 124.85 ppm. Each of these appears twice, indicating two equivalent sets of each carbon, i.e., 12 aromatic carbons total. Therefore the compound contains 12 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
